Africa E. prevent other regional groups from being set up in Africa

candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: The OAU was founded to

options.A: effect an immediate political union of African States
options.C: promote the unity and solidarity of African states
options.D: create a common market in sub-Saharan Africa

candidate.explanation: The OAU Charter made the unity and solidarity of African states a central purpose. It did not require immediate political union or set 1970 as a universal end date for colonialism.
